title: A Lean Formalization of the Shapley Value Characterization for Finite Cooperative Games
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: We describe a Lean 4 formalization of the standard four-axiom characterization of the Shapley value for finite transferable-utility cooperative games. Games are arbitrary real-valued characteristic functions normalized at the empty coalition; the player type may itself be empty. The factorial coalition formula is proved efficient, symmetric for interchangeable players, null-player respecting, and additive.
